notes:
v1.4.0 Update
📖 Glossaries: Add reusable world and Story glossaries with categories, search, shorthand links, hover tooltips, and backlog support.
🧭 Exploration: Hotspots can continue into another Story node instead of returning, and authors can disable hover highlights for hidden clues.
🚪 Story Entry Points: Tokens, Tiles, Actors, Regions, and the Live Director can start the same Story from different nodes with safe fallback when a node is removed.
🎭 Character Workflow: Choose portrait or token art as the default character image and filter the Live Director actor list to the current Scene.
🎬 Media and Sound: Picture actions now support webm and mp4 with loop and mute options, and GMs can mute typewriter sound for the whole world.
🐛 Performance and Cleanup: Typewriter rendering and backlog handling are faster, and speaking timers and videos stop cleanly when characters or overlays close.

announcement.title: 🌸 Visual Novel Maker v1.4.0
announcement.content:
Visual Novel Maker v1.4.0 adds reusable glossaries, flexible exploration routes, configurable Story entry points, and video Picture actions.

  • Create world or Story glossaries with categories, search, shorthand links, hover tooltips, and Dialogue Backlog support.
  • Build exploration routes that continue into another Story node, or keep the existing return-to-scene behavior.
  • Assign Tokens, Tiles, Actors, Regions, and Live Director triggers their own Story start nodes with safe fallback for removed nodes.
  • Choose portrait or token art as the character fallback and filter the Live Director actor list to the current Scene.
  • Use webm or mp4 files in Picture actions with loop and mute controls, and mute typewriter sound for the whole world.
  • Typewriter rendering and backlog handling are faster, and lip-sync timers and speaking videos stop cleanly when characters or overlays close.
